meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 装上后，当你想把记忆备份或同步到 cmem.ai 账号时，Claude 会检查云同步状态；若未配置，会请你提供 cmem.ai 里显示的三个连接值（同步令牌、用户 ID、SyncHub 地址），写入设置并重启验证。它不会显示同步令牌。
howto.when: 当你说“设置云同步”“同步我的记忆”等，或想把记忆数据库备份/同步到 cmem.ai 账号时触发。

say.text: 设置 cloud sync 云同步
say.note: 会让你提供 cmem.ai 里显示的三个连接值
回报设备 ID、待同步条数等状态

say.text: 把记忆备份到我的 cmem.ai 账号
say.note: 若未配置会引导你完成设置

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you want to back up or sync memories to your cmem.ai account, Claude checks cloud sync status; if not configured, it asks for the three connection values shown in cmem.ai (sync token, user ID, SyncHub URL), writes them, and restarts to verify. The token is never displayed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", etc., or want your memory database backed up or synced to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.note: You'll be asked for the three connection values in cmem.ai
Reports device ID, pending counts, etc.

say_en.text: Back up my memories to my cmem.ai account
say_en.note: Guides setup if not yet configured
